proposedContributions.change: Define schema-versioned declarative presentation types and runtime validation: stable block/group IDs, contentRevision/hash linkage, language/title/icon/lineStart, wrap/fold/semi-fold visibility, bounded named line/text ranges, annotations/theme and semantic named palette. Keep raw code spans in the existing authority, referenced rather than independently stored. Reject arbitrary attributes/CSS/scripts/event handlers; allow only parsed color values/tokens and explicit known fields. Retain unknown document extension payload as opaque fallback under the accepted lossless bridge, without executing it. Serialize basic highlights as ==text==, custom marks as sanitized mark/style manifest; remove only highlight marks. Produce grouped sequential titled exports with every raw line and warnings about unsupported styling; never derive authorization/redaction from fold state. Budget failures should be typed validation outcomes with machine-readable budget details using the required error union, not a ninth undocumented discriminant. Proposed symbol names are design requests, not existing code evidence.

Build presentation chrome/preview on the existing code NodeView and authenticated dependency host, not a second editor. Include filename/language/icon, line numbers/start, wrap/fold/semi-fold, range/text highlights, group tabs, annotations/theme, exact-code copy and image-copy export preview. Render text as text and allowlisted marks, never dangerouslySetInnerHTML from imports. Reuse existing hover/dropdown mechanisms via an approved composition seam; selection editing preserves NodeViewContent/IME/undo. UI receives current capabilities/ref/revision/hash and durable receipts from the native owner. Revision changes invalidate decorations and cancel bounded worker jobs. All copy/export paths use retained raw code, not visible DOM. No component-local durable store. Compile runtime request/result/error schemas at both renderer and accepted server boundary; the UI contract file alone cannot create server enforcement.

Permanent tests cover actual roundtrip/edit boundaries and rejection behavior: CRLF/LF, tabs, trailing spaces/newlines, empty code, Unicode, embedded fence lengths, literal currency/maths/sentinel strings, reverse/remove marks, line-range bounds, grouped exports/all folded lines, safe/unsafe marks and worker cancellation/budget outcomes. Retain deterministic reproduction seeds/input digests; generate the specified export/event-handler mutants with exact semantic assertion receipts. These tests must invoke real codec/worker/domain behavior, not source-text checks or mock echoes.

risks: Root-owned wave0 edits are live: editor hash already differs from normative source; line-based requests become stale on the next integration change.
The exact explicit dependency array hides published RS-DOC-01 Drive/Messaging/CRDT obligations; do not silently add edges, claim them satisfied or reduce acceptance to renderer-only.

Private TiptapCodeBlockView fixes copy and NodeView registration; an editor-only integration may otherwise duplicate the existing language menu or leave obsolete code. Additional approved composition scope is required.

node.textContent/token.text/Markdown reserialization cannot establish original CRLF/trailing-byte fidelity; global currency marker replacements and document-ia trimming/sanitization can alter literal code.
Fixed triple-fence output can misrepresent code containing fence delimiters; retained-span/delimiter-safe fallback must be exercised, not assumed.
No inspected native server seam can prove auth/CAS/idempotency/durability/export grants; command registry visibility and editable=false are not authorization boundaries.
Shared Doc/Map palette and all ten locales are outside current allocated writes; displaying a code-only palette is incomplete Highlightr behavior.
A synchronous renderer regex plus setTimeout is not bounded execution. Worker CSP/bundling/termination needs actual Electron proof and a typed failure contract.
Dark Shiki !important background may obscure highlight tokens; inherited controls are smaller than published hitbox gates and animation/focus return need scoped actual-app verification.
Local fold/cache state cannot serve as durable presentation persistence or secret redaction; exports/current grants and print of inactive tabs require native owner receipts.

Published Page collaborative_document and legacy Markdown-first extension lanes have different authority requirements; adding a parallel JSON/Markdown master or claiming a Markdown NodeView is a ready CRDT editor violates the foundation contract.

This artifact intentionally supplies source-level plans and precise integration requests only; all eight DoD items and supplemental source-specified behaviors remain unverified until integrated native/runtime/UI evidence exists.
